observations.behavior: Adds org-specific URL parsing and conclusion extraction; P1.F2.H5 adds identity checks against Depot app ID and PR number.

observations.behavior: Reads up to ~2MB of JSON before decoding; raises ValueError on oversized responses.
observations.posthog_connection: Protects against DoS-style payloads in the Depot API while still allowing normal-sized check-run lists. Relevant for reliability and safety of this relay dependency.

observations.behavior: Adds tests rejecting malformed details URLs, including userinfo injection and non-HTTPS schemes.
observations.posthog_connection: These assertions support safe handling of Depot metadata. The patch does not change production behavior but demonstrates defensive expectations around untrusted input.

observations.limitations: All hunks are confined to .github/scripts/ci_backend_relay.py and its test file. No changes appear in PostHog application code, database migrations, or shared dependencies that would demonstrate broader systemic benefit. Tier 3 requires cross-component implementation and validation, which is absent. Tier 2 could apply if the script were shown as a critical path with demonstrated correctness and checks, but no adoption or incident avoidance evidence exists. This remains a narrow maintenance improvement.
